title: This Is Exactly How I TRADE DMC (Day trading Strategy)
creator: Dumb Money Hunter | Maven Founder
scope: Separate research version; no live bot, BAT, website catalogue or portfolio membership changes.
assumptions: Confirmed body pivots: two closed bars on each side; the forming candle is excluded.
Weekly, daily and H4 pivot-body zones map levels. H1 pivot zones approximate trend starts; completed-close structure breaks define D1/H1 direction.
Trend-following M15 rejections at H1 zones require agreeing D1/H1 directions. Counter-trend M15 rejection scalps at W1/D1/H4 zones are permitted, as in the video example.
M15 close beyond the latest confirmed M15 pivot can arm a break-and-retest entry, expiring after eight M15 bars.
Stop beyond both the zone and signal-bar extreme plus 0.1 M15 ATR(14). No creator-specified numeric stop was available.
Target nearest mapped W1/D1/H4/H1 body-pivot level in the trade direction; no fixed R cap. Skip room below 0.25R or broker stop constraints.
Move stop to entry at +0.5 initial R, only if the broker permits. Price break-even is not net cash break-even after costs.
One position at a time, all sessions; no daily trade cap or forced time exit. A traded zone can rearm after price closes through its far edge.
New model floors lot size to 1% current equity; existing models retain their original upward rounding, which can exceed nominal risk slightly.
Existing controls retain exact selected entry, session and dynamic trailing settings. BTC control is a Fresh Reaction US100-rules transfer, not an existing active BTC DMC.
Raw retrospective reconstruction, not optimisation, untouched OOS, institutional validation or a claim to reproduce the creator's discretionary trades.
